page.layout: One text column, full width. Running head and page number at the top. Above the text, a centred division heading "CONCIO IIII." with a verse reference "Genes. 9." below it. An epigraph in italic beside a woodcut initial. Below it, the running text in paragraphs. No marginal notes. Gathering signature "C 5" at the foot, right.

main_text.l: honestatem labefactant, importare. Exem-
plo est Salomon, cuius cor per mulieres alie-
nigenas legitur a Deo aversum fuisse, 3. Re-
gum undecimo.
Denique ne secundum carnem vinamus[?],
ne spiritu vivificate privemur & moriamur
in æternum: à qua morte fervet nos Domi-
nus Iesus, Amen.
CONCIO IIII.
Genes. 9.
I Qui matrimonium commendare solent,
commendant illud non solum, ab authori-
tate instituentis, qui ipse Deus est, non Au-
gustin. non Benedictus, non alius quispiam
vel homo, vel angelus: nec solum à loco, in
quo institutum est, id est, paradiso, à statu,
scil. innocentiæ, ab antiquitate, ab eo quod
legimus de matre Domini, quæ hunc ordinem
intrare voluit, inq; eo Christum peperit, ab
eo, quòd Dominus voluit honorare nuptias
sua præsentia, & primo miraculo, quod fe-
cit coram discipulis suis: verum etiam ex eo,
quòd nunc solum ordinem salvavit Deus
tempore diluuij, quo finito, eundem denuò
confirmauit. In arca enim tantum salvati

page.notes: Woodcut initial at the start of the epigraph is a decorative frame; the letter inside is read as T and joined to "benedixit" (doubtful: may be B, as Gen. 9:1 reads Benedixit). "vinamus" in the first paragraph continuation is doubtful and may be "vivamus". "privemur" read from "priuemur", with the u/v rule applied. Long s printed as f in "fecundum" and "Genef." read as plain s. The page number "31" and running head are printed at the top; "C 5" is the gathering signature at the foot.
